augmentations.name: Bionic Oculus
augmentations.detail: Computerized eyes overlaid with augmented reality interface, including quick-referencing faces to local database searches, locating other networked devices (such as security cameras), and limited zoom and camera features.
augmentations.label: Bionic Oculus (Eyes Socket)

augmentations.name: Backup Heart
augmentations.detail: If you would die, automatically survive but this Augment is destroyed and the socket is permanently disabled. Stabilize and restore all HP. Backup heart will only keep you alive for 1D6 hours, so seek immediate medical attention.
augmentations.label: Backup Heart (Internal Socket)

augmentations.name: Bionic Tendons
augmentations.detail: Allows you to fall from up to 50 feet and land gracefully without any consequences. Falls up to 100 feet also get ADV on Saves.
augmentations.label: Bionic Tendons (2 Leg Sockets)

augmentations.name: Mag-Steel Arm
augmentations.detail: Requires losing your entire arm, otherwise elective replacement permanently removes 1 WIL score from the trauma. Advantage with STR saves. Can effortlessly crush most small or medium objects.
augmentations.label: Mag-Steel Arm (Arm Socket)

augmentations.name: Shiva Harness
augmentations.detail: Back plate that connects to your sympathetic nervous system. Can open to reveal a mechanical arm on each side.
augmentations.label: Shiva Harness (Torso Socket)

augmentations.name: Plasti-Scale Skin Graft
augmentations.spec: Skin Socket, requires severe burn damage
augmentations.detail: Spray-on synthetic skin from sea-creature DNA. Only adheres to burn wounds. +3 Armor vs Thermal/Heat/ Fire.
augmentations.label: Plasti-Scale Skin Graft (Skin Socket, requires severe burn damage)

augmentations.name: Frog Tongue Mutation
augmentations.detail: You have a long sticky tongue that extends 20 feet. 1D6 damage and can grab small objects.
augmentations.label: Frog Tongue Mutation (Lower Face Socket)

augmentations.name: Edited Pheromones
augmentations.detail: You have a pleasing fragrance to most other humanoid species, giving you +2 to reaction rolls.
augmentations.label: Edited Pheromones (Internal Socket)

augmentations.name: Self-Sterilizing Liver
augmentations.detail: You are immune to all ingested poisons.
augmentations.label: Self-Sterilizing Liver (Internal Socket)

augmentations.name: Basilisk Gland
augmentations.detail: Spit acid in a cone once a day (1D8 biological, blast, 30 feet)
augmentations.label: Basilisk Gland (Lower Face Socket)

augmentations.name: Star Slug
augmentations.detail: You are the symbiotic host to an alien slug. It crawls into your ear and tells you things. The star slug lets you talk to any creature of animal intelligence. Must eat something living every 7 days or the Star Slug will die, permanently lowering your WIL by 1.
augmentations.label: Star Slug (Neural Socket)

augmentations.name: Servant of the Dead Moon
augmentations.detail: You willingly let an otherworldly force enter your mind, sharing knowledge with your bones and blood. Under a full moon, your skin glows with a soft light. You can project your voice into the minds of others up to 100’
augmentations.label: Servant of the Dead Moon (2 Internal Sockets)

augmentations.name: Devil-Leopard Mutation
augmentations.detail: Exposure to alien bacteria has mutated your skin crimson red with dark indigo spots. You can crack most metal and bones with your teeth.
augmentations.label: Devil-Leopard Mutation (1 Internal & Skin Sockets)

augmentations.name: Mask of Pale Starlight
augmentations.detail: Splash your face with this silvery liquid. Your face can change at will. Save against corruption.
augmentations.label: Mask of Pale Starlight (Eyes and Lower Face Socket)
